user_questions.question: Who should be members of the new Ghost Kitchen Sales Team queue? Options: (a) specific named users, (b) a role such as an existing sales role, (c) a public group, (d) create the queue empty and add members after deployment. Evidence: no role, group, or user in the org is identified with ghost kitchens. Recommendation: (d).
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.

user_questions.question: How should routing be implemented? Options: (a) add an entry to the existing active 'Standard' lead assignment rule (its entries cannot be read, and it only fires when the rule is applied), or (b) a new record-triggered flow on Lead create that sets the owner for Ghost Kitchen leads only. Recommendation: (b).
user_questions.simulated_answer: Business Type = Ghost Kitchen goes to the Ghost Kitchen sales queue; other leads unchanged. No preference on mechanism otherwise.

skill_friction: Step 5 says 'decide, don't ask' unless both conditions hold; queue membership and mechanism (assignment rule vs flow) were borderline. I asked, but both had clear defaults, so the questions may have been unnecessary under a strict reading.

The queue name ('Ghost Kitchen Sales Team' vs the hidden intent's 'Ghost Kitchen Sales') was treated as a label detail per Rule 5, but the queue DeveloperName is an inventory API name; SKILL.md does not say whether an API name the requirement implies but does not state is a label default or a scope question.

AskCoworker repeatedly tagged facts I sent as 'Verified: prior session' and made wrong platform claims (per-record SOQL in record-triggered flows, hard-coded queue Id, QueueSobject as separate deployable row, before-save ordering vs assignment rules); the skill handles this via the 'fix from evidence' rule, which worked, but there is no guidance on order-of-execution checks for assignment rules vs flows.
Assignment rule entries are unreadable with allowed commands; org-verification.md mentions this but gives no recommended design stance when the requirement is routing (flow vs rule edit).
